items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And Roche had a good band, a musical, you know.

ctx.x: What did that balloon look like? The music sound better in the pavilion, the skating rink was bare for that. Yes. But people liked golden better. And they could dance better on the floor. And Roche had a good band, a musical, you know. Yes.
